newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian Airlines Q3 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Canadian Airlines Q3 net falls.

text.p: Canadian Airlines Corp said on Friday its Canadian Airlines International unit had third-quarter net income of C$85.7 million in 1996 compared to C$98.9 million in the same period last year, bringing the airline's loss for the first nine months of 1996 to C$49.0 million, compared to a loss of C$65.4 million in 1995.
No per share earnings were given. The company said it would release full results at 1200 EST/1700 GMT.
Canadian said the year-to-date results reflect a small improvement over last year but are "significantly worse than planned."
It blamed the results on higher fuel prices, the effects of a weakening yen and downward pressure on fares.
Operating revenues were down C$37.1 million in the third quarter on load factors that increased to 79.8 percent, while capacity was consistent with the prior year, Canadian said.
It said third-quarter operating expenses were down C$11.6 million and operating costs per available seat mile has been reduced 2.3 percent to C$0.1168.
